title: Mustard Herb Potato Salad
fullMethod: Wash potatoes and dice into 2cm cubes, retain thin clean skins.
Cover with cold water, simmer 12–18 min until fork tender and intact.
Drain, steam off for 5 min, spread in shallow dish to cool.
Whisk mayo, yoghurt, Dijon, lemon juice and salt.
Finely slice spring onion, chop parsley, dice drained pickles and mix into dressing.
Fold dressing through cooled potatoes, cover and refrigerate at 5C or below 45 minutes.
